chapter: Casimir, Bigard and Allen's brass band
title: Who played in Old Man Allen's brass band
summary: Alvin Alcorn, Happy on bass drum, and Allen's brother George on snare, with Remus the best brass band snare drummer.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh, who was in Old Man Allen's brass band? I forgot to ask you that.
Old Man Allen's brass band? Mm-hmm. Well, he'd, Old Man Allen's, hire old men like, uh, little Alvin Alcorn, you know him? Mm-hmm. Huh?
Oh, yeah, I remember when he was with Allen.

Well, Alvin Alcorn. That's in my town. He used to hire lots of other fellows like that to come play with him, like, uh, used to have, uh, Happy playing drum. Mm-hmm. And, uh... Which Happy? The Happy that studied. You know Happy that studied? Black Happy. Yeah, Black Happy. Gold. Well, Happy used to play bass drum with him. Yeah. And, uh, Old Man Allen had a brother by the name of George used to play the snare drum. Mm-hmm.
I don't know anything about him. Did he play in any dance band? Sit down and talk?

No, his brother George, he, that's all he played was snare drums, something like Remus. You see? Mm-hmm. Well, his brother George, he left away from there and went, uh, live in Morgan City. Mm-hmm. That's where he died, over in Morgan City. Could he play pretty good snare drums? Well, he wasn't much of a snare drum player, but he, he'd fill in on the count of his brother was the leader of the band, Old Man Allen, but he'd always use his brother on the snare drum, you know? Mm-hmm. Remus was about the best snare drum player for brass bands. He knows he could play the snare drum for brass bands, he would say.
I used to always like Arthur Ogle, you know Arthur Hogan? Huh? You remember Arthur Hogan? Yeah. Ogle, he was good, too. Yeah, yeah. And Alfred Wiggins, they were good. A lot of good ones.
